apps.name: DuckTV: IPTV & M3U Player
apps.description:
DuckTV is a player. It does not provide, sell, or host any TV channels, streams, or IPTV subscriptions, and it comes with no content of any kind. There is nothing to watch until you sign in with an account you already have from a provider you already pay. You bring the account; DuckTV brings the interface.

If you already have an Xtream Codes or M3U login from your provider, type the server address, your username and your password, and DuckTV turns that line into a proper TV app on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad.

WHAT DUCKTV IS NOT
• Not a channel provider. No channels, no playlists, no streams are bundled.
• Not a subscription service for television. There is no signup, no provider directory, and no way to buy TV inside the app.
• Not tied to any one company. Any standards-compliant Xtream Codes panel works.

WHAT YOU GET

Live TV that behaves like television
One playback engine, so changing channel is instant instead of a reload. Slide-in channel and category lists, a now/next info bar, favourites, recent channels, and a full time-grid guide with a live now-line when your provider sends EPG data. Prefer a better guide than your panel ships? Point DuckTV at your own XMLTV URL instead.

Movies and Series
Your provider's on-demand catalogue in a poster grid with categories, sorting and search. Playback remembers where you stopped, and picks the next episode up automatically.

Search
One field across live channels, movies and series.

Sports
Live scores, schedules and standings for NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, college football and basketball, major soccer competitions and Formula 1 — pulled from public sports data, not from your provider. A spoiler shield hides scores until you ask for them. If you play Yahoo Fantasy, you can connect your Yahoo account (an integration Yahoo has approved) to see your team, your matchup and your players alongside the game.

Multiview
Watch several channels at once in a grid on Apple TV, with audio following the tile you pick.

DVR
Record live TV to the device and play it back from the DVR tab.

Parental controls
A PIN that hides categories you choose, and hides adult categories across Live TV, Movies and Series until the PIN is entered. Because the channels come from your provider and not from us, DuckTV cannot know or filter what is on them — these controls, and your provider's own account settings, are how you decide what is reachable on your device.

A player that actually plays things
DuckTV uses VLC (libVLC) as well as Apple's own engine, so MPEG-TS, HEVC and MKV streams that AVPlayer refuses simply play. Buffer size, hardware decoding and stream format are yours to tune, and an optional stats overlay shows bitrate, resolution and frame rate while you watch.

Built for the remote and for the phone
The Apple TV app is built around the focus engine and the Siri Remote. The iPhone and iPad app is a real touch app — not a stretched TV layout — with Picture in Picture for on-demand playback and background audio.

PRIVACY
Your server address, username and password are stored on your device in the keychain and sent only to your provider. They are never sent to us. There are no ads, no ad identifiers and no third-party tracking SDKs. Anonymous diagnostics can be switched off entirely in Settings → Privacy. Yahoo Fantasy and DuckTrack only do anything if you connect them yourself.

ONE MORE TIME, BECAUSE IT MATTERS
DuckTV has no relationship with any IPTV provider and does not recommend, endorse or resell one. What you watch, and whether you have the right to watch it, is between you and whoever you get your line from. Use DuckTV only with content you are authorised to access.

Requires an Apple TV, iPhone or iPad running tvOS/iOS 17 or later, an internet connection, and your own Xtream Codes or M3U account from a provider.

Questions, or something not working? help@duckingstats.com

apps.name: Heukino – IPTV Player
apps.description:
Heukino is the elegant, lightning-fast IPTV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Vision Pro — built to feel the way an Apple app should.

Heukino 2.0 grew almost entirely out of your requests — and it can be tailored to the way you watch TV like few other players can. We’re doing everything we can to become the best streaming app on the market. Being close to our users and supporting them is especially important to us: every message reaches us directly.

NEW IN 2.0: themes and accent colors, manage and rename channels yourself, your own favorites lists, a Catch-up overview, back to “Live” after a pause — and Heukino now on Apple Vision Pro too.

IMPORTANT: Heukino does not include any content, channels or subscriptions. You connect your own legal IPTV source — an Xtream login or an M3U/M3U8 playlist with XMLTV EPG — and Heukino turns it into a first-class television experience.

LIVE TV, DONE RIGHT
• Instant channel switching thanks to smart pre-buffering
• A beautiful program guide (EPG) with a live now-line, pinch to zoom and time travel by swipe
• Reminders for upcoming programs — right on time or with a head start
• Multi-View: watch up to 4 channels at once and switch audio with a tap
• Catch-up for providers with an archive: watch programs you missed

MOVIES & SERIES
• Cinematic shelves with HD posters, ratings and details (bring your own TMDb/OMDb keys)
• Continue Watching across all your devices — progress syncs via iCloud
• Auto-play the next episode, season overview, and notifications when your favorite series get new episodes
• Trakt scrobbling for your watch history (bring your own Trakt account)

A PLAYER FOR (ALMOST) EVERY FORMAT
• Hybrid engine: native Apple playback plus a built-in engine for MKV, AVI, TS and more
• 4K, HDR10, HLG, Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos — whenever your stream provides it
• Sleep Timer, playback speed, volume boost up to 200% — plus AirPlay and Picture in Picture on iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Subtitles your way: size, color, outline, background — plus OpenSubtitles search (bring your own key)
• Chapter navigation and audio track selection

MADE FOR YOU
• Profiles with Parental PIN
• AI recommendations computed 100% on your device — nothing is ever sent anywhere
• Favorites, progress and profiles on all your devices via iCloud
• 50+ languages, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type

HEUKINO PREMIUM
Heukino is free to download; all playback features are part of Heukino Premium. Choose a subscription — Solo or Family (up to 6 people via Family Sharing), monthly or yearly, each with a 7-day free trial — or buy once with Lifetime, available as Solo or Family: pay one time, use it forever, no subscription. Subscriptions renew automatically and can be canceled anytime in your account settings.

Note: Heukino is a player only. Your IPTV provider is responsible for content, availability and rights. Only use Heukino with sources you are licensed to access.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
apps.releaseNotes:
Heukino 2.0 is built almost entirely from your emails, reviews and requests. Thank you!

NEW
• Themes and accent color: background and colors to your taste, plus True Black for OLED screens and alternate app icons on iPhone and iPad.
• Favorites in your own order and in your own lists, optionally split into Live TV, Movies, Series and Reminders.
• Manage channels yourself: hide, rename, assign your own numbers. Duplicate channels (HD, FHD, 4K) can be combined into one — if one version fails, Heukino switches to the next.
• Channel list as shelves, as a list or with a sidebar, showing what's on now and next. Movies and Series optionally in a classic view with categories alongside.
• Channel list over the running picture: switch channels without leaving the player.
• Live button in the player: after a pause, one press brings you back to what's happening now.
• Catch-up overview: every channel with an archive in one place — pick a day and catch up on the show.
• Guide: only your favorites if you like, filter by bouquet, adjustable row height and time offset.
• Home your way: show, hide and reorder shelves, save searches — and pick up where you left off when you open the app.
• Player: aspect ratio, skip intervals, a sleep timer until the end of the program, next episode automatically. Heukino can remember audio, subtitles and audio delay for each channel.
• Subtitles: preferred language, on automatically for foreign-language audio or always, styled as set in Accessibility.
• Reminders open the channel directly; if you like, Heukino switches over when the show starts.
• Playlists: edit them, protect them with a PIN, refresh them all at once and sort them yourself.
• Widgets on iPhone and iPad, your choice of what the Top Shelf shows on Apple TV, Focus filters, and a Playback menu on the Mac.

IMPROVED
• Fast start: your channels are there right away; updating happens in the background.
• Channels that used to stutter even though the connection was fast enough now play smoothly — on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV.
• Picture but no sound? If a provider sends the audio with shifted timestamps, Heukino now compensates for it on its own.
• The guide keeps itself up to date — even on slow connections and when the app stays open for a long time.
• Apple TV: the guide has been rebuilt so that scrolling down no longer stutters with large playlists.
• When all streams on your account are in use, Heukino now says so clearly.
• After switching profiles, nothing the previous profile had open is visible anymore — important for kids' profiles.

NOW ON APPLE VISION PRO
Heukino is now built for Apple Vision Pro: open channels as windows and place them anywhere in your space.

Many of the new customization options are part of Heukino Premium.

UP NEXT
Heukino for iPhone Duo.

KEEP WRITING TO ME
Something missing, something bothering you, or can another app do something Heukino can't? Write to me. I look at every request and build what can sensibly be built.

apps.releaseNotes:
This update unblocks several situations where the app became unusable, and adds live rewind, a full programme guide, and much richer film pages.

WITHOUT A CONNECTION

• The app no longer hangs at startup when there is no network. It says so plainly instead of reporting an authentication error.
• Your downloads stay reachable from that screen: they are the content that genuinely works offline.
• Losing the network while using the app leads there too.
• As soon as the network returns, the app picks up on its own.

DOWNLOADS

• An interrupted download — locked screen, lost network, app closed — resumes where it stopped instead of starting over.
• It no longer vanishes from your list: it stays visible, with a button to restart it.
• Resuming is now automatic after a drop, with nothing to go back to.
• Progress no longer falls back to zero after a failure, and an incomplete file can no longer be played by mistake.

LIVE TV

• New: rewind live television from 30 seconds up to 30 minutes on the channels your provider archives. The bar appears only on those.
• A navigation bar at the bottom of the player lets you aim at a precise moment, and return to live with one gesture.

PROGRAMME GUIDE

• New: a guide reachable from the header and from the Live page. Each channel shows what is on now, how far along it is, and what follows.
• It opens on your favorites, and search finds a programme by its title, not only a channel by its name.
• Selecting a channel opens its full schedule, live and catch-up alike.
• It now works with M3U sources and not only compatible portals: its address is read from the playlist itself.

MOVIES AND SERIES

• Film pages now show the title logo, a backdrop, the cast with the characters they play, and a synopsis in your language.
• Playback starts straight away when a version in your language exists, instead of asking every time.
• The wait before playback is markedly shorter on films with several versions.
• A versions button shows how many exist and lets you pick another, 4K included.
• New setting: prefer the lighter version. Useful on slow connections.

TITLES AND TEXT

• Titles and categories in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Cyrillic and Arabic no longer appear as unreadable characters, whatever the source.
• Titles written in a non-Latin alphabet are back in the home selections, where they were missing.
• Resuming a film no longer restarts at another title's position.
• French titles carrying a single accent now display correctly.

DISPLAY AND NAVIGATION

• On iPhone, navigation stays in portrait while the player rotates freely — the interface is no longer stretched when the device is lying down.
• The sign-in page scrolls, and its content no longer slides under the notch.
• A live channel no longer appears by mistake in Continue Watching.
• Opening a series no longer throws an error screen when its page is incomplete.
• A decoding hiccup on a live channel no longer covers a picture that is still playing with a full-screen error.

ACCOUNT

• New: connect another device to your account by entering a short code from a device already signed in. No password to retype.
• Deleting an account now warns that it does not cancel your App Store subscription, and offers a direct way to manage it.
• A subscription can no longer be bought without an account, which would have attached it to nothing. The screen offers to sign in, then resumes the purchase.
• Adding a source: the library no longer shows up empty on first launch.
